senses.gloss: f. pl. (reduplic. of קָנֶה) [little reeds, tubes.] branch sinews of the nervus ischiadicus; thin branches of the grape vine.
units: Ib. 92ᵃ ק׳ שבה וכ׳ the rods on the grape vine are typical of the empty (meritless) in Israel.—[Ab. d’R. N. ch. XL קינוקנות (Var. כִּידוֹן) chastising rods.]
